name: agent_stop
description: Stop a delegated child run: its engine (or container) is killed, its execution slot frees immediately (the spawn queue advances), its credential is revoked, and the stop is journaled. The session stays resumable — a later agent_send relaunches its harp as a fresh run primed with its recorded history.

run_id.description: The child run to stop (from spawn's child_run_id, or the roster's current run_id — a resumed child runs under a FRESH run_id)
